writeup: La Roche-Posay's Cicaplast Balm B5 is the derm-favorite balm for cracked, chapped and irritated skin, safe for babies one week and up. Woot has it for $8.99, while Walmart and Target both charge about $19 for the 1.35 oz tube. Woot listed only one, limit one per customer.
